items.title: Tropical Storm Rachel's aftermath: deaths and missing persons in Baja California
items.summary: Baja California Gov. Marina del Pilar said at least 10 people were reported missing and a young girl dead in the aftermath of Tropical Storm Rachel, with more than 50 people in temporary shelters (AP wire). A second outlet, GG North, reports flooding near Ensenada left 1 dead and 7 missing, a partial evacuation of Ensenada's IMSS Bienestar General Hospital (water leaks and electrical failures), more than 4,000 emergency reports and 200+ rescues statewide, and school suspensions Monday. Figures vary between outlets as the situation develops. Earlier in this watch, President Sheinbaum had already noted Rachel's impacts in Baja California were greater than Simon's on the mainland.

items.title: Man dies after being pulled from Rachel-fueled surf at Dockweiler Beach, Los Angeles
items.summary: A man was pulled unconscious from the ocean near Tower 42 at Dockweiler Beach, Playa del Rey, on Sunday morning and pronounced dead after about 20 minutes of resuscitation efforts, per Surfer citing KTLA. Police found no indication of foul play. The death was initially reported as a drowning, but the LA County Medical Examiner will determine the official cause; the lifeguard specialist noted a medical emergency was also possible. The incident came amid a High Surf Advisory (5-8 ft breaking waves, powerful rip currents) driven partly by former Hurricane Rachel, plus severe coastal flooding across Southern California.
